# `oaap app artifact-index`

internal: list retained packages where the portal can read them (oaap.apps.runtime 2.14).

Internal: called by the platform itself (update, install, the portal or a timer). Not meant to be typed by hand.

**Root:** needs `sudo`.

## Usage
